_note: Predeclared before any run; not edited after results are seen. Row text and storage key are private: ROUND_EXPECT_PRIVATE = {salt, values}; commitment = sha256(salt + compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of values). Only T1 PASS counts toward a release. T1-env cases are environment checks only. Round 3 also seeds two pinned clipboard items and one personal-dictionary word through the previous build's UI before the update and checks them after it. The driver always exits 0; job colour reflects infrastructure only. Round 3 (rc5): the settings row is always listed, so row_visible is true in every state; English (US) with the toggle on and Bangla (Latin) added is predeclared k2; the diagnostics session log must show a current caller=voice enbn-gate yes line in the English (US) toggle-on lane (see cases.V3-gate-log).

cases.A1-fresh-install: install Success; versionCode equals version_code.candidate; base.apk sha equals the pin; single APK; not debuggable/test-only; no sharedUserId; no instrumentation

cases.B2-S2-latin: row under test present with its description when Bangla (Latin) is enabled
cases.B1-default-off-ui: row switch unchecked when first shown
cases.B4-cancel: leaving without tapping keeps the switch unchecked and storage absent/false
cases.B3-on: one tap: switch checked and storage true
cases.B2-S3-both: row present when both Bangla keyboards are enabled
cases.B3-persist-switch: still checked/true after adding another keyboard

cases.A2-base: previous release installs on a fresh emulator; versionCode equals version_code.previous; bytes equal its pin
cases.A2-update: Same-versionCode, same-certificate REPLACEMENT (not a version upgrade): base = rc3d (Rambler Bangla v29.3-rc3d, sha256 cd17332024043a08bc8f5f86d532479df8f858bdf692f5056356398ca73854c7) replaced by the rc5 candidate; both versionCode 176004243 (read from the APK bytes). Setup, else BLOCKED: apksigner certificate SHA-256 digests of the pinned base and candidate files equal and readable (checked before install); INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE = BLOCKED. PASS needs: install -r Success; base pin != candidate pin; installed base.apk equals the base pin before and the candidate pin after; versionCode before/after as pinned; uid and firstInstallTime unchanged; lastUpdateTime changed; default IME unchanged. dumpsys signatures are saved as evidence only. A Play or other distributed update would need a versionCode bump; this case does not test that.
cases.A2-state-survives: state seeded through the previous build's UI (diagnostics on, Bangla (Bangladesh) keyboard added) is the same after the update; prefs/database files still present
cases.V0-recognition-service: a RecognitionService exists on the image (environment check) (T1-env)
cases.V1-mic-ui: voice key shows the microphone permission prompt (permission not pre-granted) or a listening state; on a -noaudio emulator image, a proven key tap that surfaces neither is an emulator-limit UNTESTED, not a product FAIL
cases.V2-recognition: UNTESTED: no audio input on the emulator

cases.A2-survive-clip-pins: Setup through the previous build's UI, else UNTESTED: clipboard turned on, two clips (keeppinone, keeppintwo) each typed into the focused field (field text proven equal to the clip), selected and copied (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C), the field cleared and proven clear before the next clip, then both pinned via the stock long-press Pin item, each then proven pinned (its long-press menu offers Unpin, not Pin). Only checked after A2-update passes (else UNTESTED). After the update, in the same text field: clipboard still on, both clips visible and each still pinned (Unpin offered) = PASS; any missing, unpinned, or clipboard off = FAIL; clipboard UI not drivable = UNTESTED. Files in app data containing the strings are saved as evidence only.
cases.A2-survive-dictionary: Setup through the previous build's UI, else UNTESTED: keyboard settings > Dictionary > Personal dictionary > All languages (else the first English entry; the exact entry chosen is recorded) > Add, word rmblkeepword proven in the editor field, then proven listed in that same entry. Only checked after A2-update passes (else UNTESTED). After the update, the SAME recorded entry lists the word = PASS; that entry reached but word absent = FAIL; that entry not reachable = UNTESTED.
cases.V3-gate-log: Required: V3-lane-english-on (a caller=voice enbn-gate line is written only when the voice subtype reports English and the toggle is on) and BOTH negative controls V3-lane-latin-off and V3-lane-english-off. Preconditions, provenance and binding as for the V3 lanes (unmet preconditions = BLOCKED, missing provenance = UNTESTED); for english-on and both controls, an invalid active snapshot, any unbound current voice-launch line, or no bound current voice-launch line = UNTESTED before any gate PASS. Only enbn-gate lines with t at or after the marker count; caller=settings lines are evidence only and never scored. Malformed enbn-gate lines: datable, current, caller=voice = FAIL; datable caller=settings = evidence only; undatable or no readable caller = UNTESTED. english-on: no current voice line = UNTESTED; any current voice line that is 'no', tog=off, or names an error in a decisive step (app, imm, list, own, hash, secure; token match -err\b) = FAIL; otherwise PASS. Each control: a current voice line with the toggle proven off = FAIL; no bound current voice-launch ('subtype ... -> kN') line = UNTESTED (absence would prove nothing); otherwise PASS. V3-lane-latin-on is evidence only here (its lane k2 grade stands). Overall: any FAIL = FAIL, else any BLOCKED = BLOCKED, else any UNTESTED = UNTESTED, else PASS.

record: round 3 / rc5 (supersedes the round-2 / rc4 expectations; the rc4 record stays in history unchanged)
first_run_checks: diagnostics export: turning diagnostics off writes a new RamblerBangla-diag-yyyyMMdd-HHmmss.txt to /sdcard/Download with a current mtime (if absent, all V3 lanes are UNTESTED, never PASS)
device date supports %N (else every V3 lane is UNTESTED)

emission timing: the 'subtype ... -> kN' and caller=voice enbn-gate lines are written at the mic tap (static trace: Gboard VoiceImeUtils builds the dictation request -> lockVoiceCandidates -> voiceLockKind -> currentLayout3 -> classifyLayout3 + adjust + logSubtype3); if they are missing after the marker, lanes read UNTESTED

subtype binding (locale format + hash identity): on the first device run, confirm for en_US (English (US)) and bn__#Latn (Bangla (Latin)) that the lane line's locale field (InputMethodSubtype.getLocale()) equals the dumpsys mSubtypeLocale for the active subtype, and that its hash field (InputMethodSubtype.hashCode()) equals the secure selected_input_method_subtype value and the dumpsys mSubtypeHashCode. Matching uses the locale field or the tag field after lowercasing and '-' -> '_'; the tag (getLanguageTag(), e.g. bn-Latn) is not expected to equal bn__#Latn and is not needed. The evidence keeps active_snapshot and every parsed subtype line with its bound flag. If a correct line does not bind, the lanes and V3-gate-log read UNTESTED, never PASS
lane_line: HH:mm:ss.SSS subtype locale=<l> extras=<e> tag=<t> hash=<h> -> k<N> (post-adjust lane, written when Gboard builds the dictation request at the mic tap; 'gate:voice-k3' needs recognized text and is evidence only)
root_reads: Root (adb root, proven per phase) is required for: stored-setting reads (B1, B3, the post-force-stop checks that gate every V3 lane), pid map grounding, and A2 state files. Without root these read UNREADABLE and the affected cases are UNTESTED or BLOCKED, never PASS.
